what: Distinct verdicts that Showdown's TeamValidator returns for a SET declared by a fixture in this repo. engine/fixture_legality.js sweeps every declaration; tests/test-fixture-legality.js reports these and FAILS on a verdict that is not listed here.
why: The clause was added 2026-08-13 and every one of these predates it. Repairing forty fixtures in the pass that ADDS the check makes both unattributable — the same reasoning already recorded in data/fixture-learnset-baseline.json, of which this is the superset. The list may only SHRINK, and the gate asserts that: a baselined verdict that stops being produced must be REMOVED, or the next illegal set hides under a stale allowance.
key: the validator's own sentence, lowercased and whitespace-collapsed. Keyed on the SENTENCE and not on file:line, so the same illegal declaration moved to a new scenario is the same defect and cannot be re-introduced as new.

kinds.DELIBERATE: the fixture stages an impossible pairing ON PURPOSE and says why — an isolation probe stamping one named control ability on every body, for instance. Legitimate; forcing a per-species legal control is the Fluffy/Sand Rush failure.
kinds.PRE-EXISTING: a real defect, held because repairing it changes what its scenario measures.

repaired.problem: Toxapex's item Black Sludge does not exist in Gen 9.
repaired.fixed: REPAIRED 2026-08-14. The item is now Leftovers. An EXISTENCE verdict is never something a probe stages on purpose, and this body sits on the bench for the whole scenario and is never sent in, so the repair moves no board. tests/test-protocol-trace.js:118.

REPAIRED 2026-08-14. Iron Defense, which Archaludon can learn. The slot never clicks its second move -- the script is Protect for six turns -- so this was a declaration defect only and the repair moves no board. tests/test-game-diff.js.

REPAIRED 2026-08-14. The singer is AZUMARILL in both files that share it (tests/test-perish-song.js and tests/test-volatile-duration.js). Derived, not chosen: exactly six legal bodies learn Perish Song and Protect together, and Azumarill is the slowest and bulkiest of them and the only one whose ability neither sets weather nor copies anything. COST: Clefable's Unaware leaves the field, and nothing in either scenario boosts, so Unaware could never have fired.
REPAIRED 2026-08-14. Body Press, which Corviknight can learn. The anchor only ever clicks Protect, so this was a declaration defect and the repair moves no board. tests/test-perish-song.js.

REPAIRED 2026-08-14. Psyshock -- 100-accurate, no secondary, and not Fire, which is the constraint the three-way case is built around. COST, named: Dazzling Gleam is a SPREAD move and Psyshock is single-target, so the click now carries a target and hits one body instead of two. The file's verdict is about the ORDER three tied bodies move in, which does not read how many were hit. tests/test-speed-tie.js.

REPAIRED 2026-08-14. Recycle -- this repo's own derived no-op (champions_sim.INERT_MOVE), which Snorlax can learn and which fails outright when the user has consumed no item. Strictly quieter than Agility, which was moving the foe's Speed two stages every turn of the probe. tests/probe_volatile_leaves.js.

REPAIRED 2026-08-14. Round and Terrain Pulse in tests/test-volatile-duration.js (both 100-accurate, no secondary, and Special so they are paid into the user's SpD rather than its Def), and Round in tests/test-perish-song.js where the slot never clicks it at all.

REPAIRED 2026-08-14. The user is ALAKAZAM. Derived: exactly seven legal bodies in this regulation learn Taunt, Encore and Disable together, and Alakazam is the fastest of them at 120 base Speed -- the nearest thing to Weavile's 125 -- and equally frail, so the survive-three-turns constraint stays real. COST, named out loud: NONE OF THE SEVEN CAN HAVE PRESSURE, so tests/test-volatile-duration.js no longer stages the DOUBLED PP rate. It still stages PP; the doubled rate is staged by tests/staged_board.js, whose Pressure bodies are actually targeted.

REPAIRED 2026-08-14. The hazard and the screen swapped bodies: Archaludon sets the rocks and Whimsicott puts up LIGHT SCREEN, because Whimsicott can learn neither Stealth Rock nor Reflect. Both mechanics survive -- a Prankster body still raises a five-turn screen and a hazard still outlives it. COST: the screen guards the special side rather than the physical one (nothing in the game attacks), and the rocks go up at normal priority rather than Prankster's +1. tests/test-game-diff.js.

REPAIRED 2026-08-14 and it was the worst entry on this list. `dex.items.get('dampro')` returns a row that does not exist whose .name is the empty string, and an empty item is a LEGAL item -- so the fixture built a Politoed HOLDING NOTHING and every check reported success. No validator verdict could ever have caught it, which is why engine/fixture_legality.js reports stray literals apart from illegal sets. The intended item is DAMP ROCK, spelled correctly in the same file's Perish Song scenario. tests/test-protocol-trace.js:131.

PRE-EXISTING. A staged-board scenario in the whole-game differential.
